instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Complete the entire task through the launched graphical user interfaces only. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, PowerShell, or any shell. Do not run Python, VBA, macros, Abaqus noGUI, ANSYS command scripts, batch/headless tools, APIs, or helper code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only the native SolidWorks and Abaqus/CAE GUI tools, menus, dialogs, editors, and built-in import, export, save, submit, and solve commands.

Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_02. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_02 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_02 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.


1. In SolidWorks, use GUI sketch and feature tools only to create a center-hole tensile coupon. Geometry requirements: overall length 120 mm, width 30 mm, thickness 3 mm, a D12 through hole at the geometric center, and straight grip regions at both ends. Export the completed CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step through the GUI and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-HoleTension. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a solid section using Steel, and assign it to the coupon. Create a Static General analysis step named Step-Tension. Create sets named LEFT_GRIP, RIGHT_GRIP, and HOLE_EDGE. Use a coarse global seed with modest local seeding only around HOLE_EDGE, and use first-order linear solid elements such as C3D8R where practical or coarse C3D4 where needed; do not use quadratic elements. Create a boundary condition named BC-LeftGrip that fixes LEFT_GRIP. Create an action named Load-RightTension: either an approximately +1 kN axial tensile load on RIGHT_GRIP, or an equivalent named axial displacement boundary condition on RIGHT_GRIP. Submit the job named Job-HoleTension and wait for the analysis to complete.
3. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-HoleTension.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-HoleTension.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

[Software] Open and use SolidWorks and Abaqus/CAE one at a time through the Windows GUI as needed. First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables.
